lead.headline: The defence add cost you Coker — claim him back
lead.deck: 2-5. Coker for Fairbairn on waivers, and Gordon into the flex over Metcalf before Sunday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. The Commanders D/ST went in at 15:13 UTC, but the player dropped was Jalen Coker, not Ka'imi Fairbairn. Coker is healthy — the Panthers took him off their injury report today — and now sits on Chem waivers until Wednesday 4 November at 02:00. Fairbairn is a second kicker on a Houston bye. Put in the claim: Coker for Fairbairn. He misses Week 8 either way. Then the lineup: the reset this afternoon moved DK Metcalf into the flex and Ollie Gordon II to the bench. The projection prefers Gordon by 2.2, and nothing reported today says otherwise — Gordon is Miami's starter with Achane out for the year. Swap them before Sunday at 12:00. AVIATO project 128.1 to Guillo-tinas' 88.7 as set, 70%.

doFirst.headline: A claim to undo, a swap before Sunday
doFirst.deck: Coker back for Fairbairn; Gordon over Metcalf in the flex.
doFirst.note: Chem priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting — but AVIATO are 10th, so a rival can take him first.
doFirst.empty: Nothing left to decide before Sunday.
